concerns.text: SC-004 (Full pipeline execution <= 6 hours) lacks a dedicated task to implement the timeout enforcement logic. T030 only logs the *result* of the timing. The spec requires the pipeline to 'automatically reduce the dataset... OR limit the number of trees' if runtime approaches a threshold. This logic is missing from the task list, making the success criterion untestable.

Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) requires every artifact to carry a content hash and update the project state YAML. Tasks T006b and T006c (Power Analysis) are marked as 'Planning Artifacts' but lack a specific task to generate the hash and update `state/projects/...yaml`. Without this, the artifacts cannot satisfy the Versioning Discipline.

SC-001 (Model accuracy > Majority Baseline + [deferred] lift) requires a mechanism to define or calculate the '[deferred] lift' threshold. Task T017c attempts to verify this but is marked 'REDO' and lacks a preceding task to establish the specific threshold value or the dynamic calculation logic required to make the criterion mathematically defined in the implementation.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires that 'No data may be modified in place; every transformation MUST produce a new file'. Task T011 states it will 'handle MemoryError by logging and excluding large molecules'. This implies data exclusion without producing a derived file or formally logging the exclusion count in a report, violating the hygiene requirement for auditability.

Task T023 (SHAP values) lists consuming `ridge_model.pkl` (a regression model artifact) to identify 'top predictive bits' for 'space group' (a classification target). This conflates the classification and regression targets defined in the spec, creating ambiguity on which target variable is being analyzed. The task description needs editing to align with the correct model artifact (RF for classification, Ridge for regression).
